title: Dutch censuses of 1909, 1920 and 1930
authors: prof.dr. H. van Dijk, Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam
descriptions: This dataset comprises data on occupations of the Dutch censuses of 1909, 1920 and 1930, and includes information on sex, occupational class and number of occurrences.
